job.job_description:
Gemini Developer

 

Technical Skills

5-10 years of relevant experience in AI and software development, with a proven track record of leading successful AI projects
Build and manage high-performance REST APIs using FastAPI, including lifecycle events and Server-Sent Events (SSE).
Develop scalable AI solutions using Azure AI Services, ensuring reliability and performance in production environments.
Build, configure, and manage AI Agents using Azure AI Foundry and similar agent orchestration platforms.
Write and integrate Python code for AI models, data ingestion pipelines, and automation workflows.
Evaluate, integrate, and optimize multi-cloud AI capabilities, including Google Vertex AI and Gemini with grounding and a comprehensive understanding of GCP infrastructure services

Qualifications & Skills

Languages: Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Go.
Frameworks/Libraries: Experience with React.js, Node.js, and modern CSS frameworks. Containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud services (Firebase, GCP) to deploy and maintain software.
Databases: Strong skills in SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
AI Technologies: Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agent frameworks, and API orchestration.
Tools: Git for version control and familiarity with Agile methodologies, AI tools like Gemini Code Assist to debug, analyze, and optimize code
